Gladiator.title: INTELLIGANCE UPDATE - v1.1
Gladiator.text:
INTELLIGANCE UPDATE - v1.1

• Staff can mark alerts as false alarms; feedback does not change detection automatically.
• Staff can find players with similar alert patterns without seeing shared addresses.
• Configuration suggestions require staff approval.
• Added seven day security and risk trends.
• Added separate anticheat settings for each world.
• Added Safe Mode to keep alerts on while suppressing punishments.
• Added searchable security logs.
• Added command and staff GUI controls for these features.
• Added diagnostics and regression tests.
• Fixed hidden blocks showing when the tracking cache filled up.
• Fixed Safe Mode handling for DDoS restrictions.
• Fixed per world module commands.
• Fixed configuration suggestion adjustments and message counts.

BUG FIXES

• Fixed hidden ore and structure blocks being exposed when the mask cache fills up.
• Fixed DDoS checks from applying new restrictions while Safe Mode is on.
• Fixed existing temporary connection restrictions being mishandled during Safe Mode.
• Fixed DDoS alerts from claiming a restriction was applied when Safe Mode suppressed it.
• Fixed Safe Mode from changing saved punishment settings.
• Fixed per world module commands not being routed correctly.
• Fixed recommendation messages displaying incorrect counts.
• Fixed recommended setting changes from using the wrong adjustment steps.

LumenShards.title: LICENCE UPDATE
LumenShards.text: Make a ticket in discord.gg/lumenstudios to claim your license.

LumenShards.title: BIG UPDATE - Quality of life update - VERSION v1.1
LumenShards.text:
What's new:

• Added offline player support: /Shard pay, /Shard take, /Shard set.
• Added an option to close the shop on purchase.
• Added shop support to sell stacks of items: x64, x2, x5.
• Added a shard leaderboard: /Shard top, /Shard leaderboard.
• Added leaderboard.db; the shard leaderboard resets if this file is deleted.
• Improved GUIs.
• Added leaderboard hologram support.
• Added versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2.
• Added /Shard Toggle pay on/off.

Bug fixes:

• Fixed being able to pay users decimal amounts.
• Switched player data storage from YAML to SQLite; switching back to YAML is available.
• Fixed being able to purchase items while inventory is full.
• Fixed decimals still showing when decimal formatting is off.
